jobs.description:
CLdN is an international logistics player with a strong European network and a clear focus on efficient and sustainable maritime connections. For CLdN RoRo Agencies NV in Zeebrugge, we are looking for a motivated Customs & Border Compliance Officer for the logistics department.
 

JOB DESCRIPTION
 

As a Customs & Border Compliance Officer, you will follow up on all customs and compliance activities within Shipping, Port and Door-to-Door processes. You act as the link between internal teams, customers and authorities, ensuring a smooth and compliant flow of goods.
 
 

• Manage customs formalities and ensure compliance with applicable legislation. 

• Apply for and follow up on permits (AEO, bonded warehouse, temporary storage, …) and liaise with 

customs and port authorities. 

• Act as the point of contact for customs-related matters and support internal and external stakeholders. 

• Prepare and improve procedures, KPIs and reporting. 

• Optimize processes and resolve operational issues. 

PROFILE
 
 

• You have a very good command of Dutch and English; additional languages are a plus. 

• You preferably have a Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics or a related field, with some exposure to customs, or are willing to quickly develop this expertise. 

• You preferably have experience or knowledge in customs, shipping or port operations, or are willing to quickly develop this expertise. 

• You are eager to learn and able to quickly process and master a large amount of complex information and legislation. 

• You have a hands-on mentality and strong problem-solving skills. 

• You possess excellent communication skills and easily build relationships with internal and external stakeholders. 

• You are willing to participate in an on-call rotation (approximately every 12 weeks, including weekends/evenings).

You will support the Customer Service team with tasks such as order entry, stock assignment, requests of certificates, etc.

 As you will progress in your training, the responsibilities can be expanded to direct customer support and coordination of the full order to cash process for a selected amount of customers.

• Act as a key point of contact for assigned customers and provide professional and timely support.
• Manage the end-to-end order process, including order entry, verification, delivery coordination and invoicing.
• Maintain accurate customer and order information in the systems.
• Provide customers and Sales colleagues with clear updates on order and delivery status.
• Prepare relevant documentation, including order confirmations, delivery documents and certificates.
• Respond to customer inquiries and help resolve order, delivery, pricing or product-related questions.
• Register and follow up on customer complaints, returns and other order-related issues.
• Work closely with Sales and internal stakeholders to ensure an efficient customer experience.
• Collaborate with colleagues across Customer Service, Supply Chain, Sales, Quality and other departments.
 

• You have experience in Customer Service, Sales Support, Order Management, Administration or a similar environment. 
• You are customer-focused, organized and comfortable managing different priorities and administrative tasks.
• You communicate clearly and enjoy working with customers and colleagues from different countries and cultures.
• You are confident working with Microsoft Excel, Outlook and Teams.
• Experience with SAP or another ERP system is considered a strong advantage.
• You are fluent in English, both spoken and written.
• Knowledge of Russian is an additional asset, but is not required.
• You work accurately, take ownership and enjoy contributing to a collaborative team environment.

jobs.occupation: English-speaking CE truck driver - frozen food transport
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced CE Driver who's living in Belgium and looking for a stable job? Do you hold a valid CE driving licence and code 95? And do you want to work at a reliable transport company where you can drive modern trucks and be home most evenings?

For a leading frozen food transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we're recruiting a CE truck driver for delivering frozen food products to customers throughout Belgium and its neighbouring countries. Dutch isn't required for this job, so you're free to apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE truck driver, lorry driver, or HGV driver, you will ensure the safe and on-time delivery of frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers.

Your drives:

• Transport of frozen goods
• National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany 
• Up to 15h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)
• Varying number of stops: between 5 to 15 stops/day
Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

• Has a valid CE driving licence, code 95 and driver card

• Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country
• Has a good level of English
• Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes
• Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby   truck cannot be taken home)
Previous experience in frozen food transport, refrigerated transport or distribution transport is an advantage but not required.

 

!! IMPORTANT ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS: please read carefully before applying !!

• You must already be living in Belgium
• You must already have a valid legal right to work in Belgium (EU citizenship or valid work permit)
Candidates who do not meet these requirements will not be considered for the position. We do not provide visa sponsorship, work permits, relocation support or immigration assistance.

jobs.occupation: Senior Project Manager CAPEX Process Industry
jobs.description:
Project overview

For this role, you will lead complex multidisciplinary CAPEX projects within the process industry. You are accountable for scope, budget, timing, quality and safety across both greenfield developments and major modifications to existing industrial facilities.

Primary tasks & responsibilities

• Direct industrial engineering projects from concept and feasibility through engineering, execution, commissioning and final handover to operations.
• Define and manage project scope, deliverables, budget, business case, investment approval and baseline planning in MS Project.
• Coordinate all project phases, including pre-study, concept selection, basic and detailed engineering, procurement, contractor selection, construction, site execution, commissioning and operational transfer.
• Act as the key point of accountability for internal stakeholders and management.
• Lead multidisciplinary teams across mechanical, electrical, automation, piping, civil and EHS disciplines, working closely with both internal and external parties.
• Manage scope changes, risks, claims and deviations that affect budget, schedule or delivery.
• Report in a structured way on project progress, issues and decisions to steering committees and senior stakeholders.

Technical profile requirements

• You bring at least 10 years of experience as a Project Manager, with proven end-to-end ownership of industrial CAPEX projects.
• You also have at least 7 years of experience as a Project Engineer in areas such as mechanical, electrical, piping or civil engineering.
• You have solid experience with pre-feasibility and concept studies, CAPEX budgeting, investment approval and the commissioning of industrial installations.
• Background in the process industry is essential.
• You have strong practical expertise in MS Project and take real ownership of project planning instead of limiting yourself to follow-up activities.
• You combine an academic level of thinking with strong analytical skills and a broad helicopter view.
Non-technical profile requirements

• You work autonomously and assume full ownership of your responsibilities.
• You show strong leadership and know how to challenge stakeholders and contractors when required.
• You communicate clearly and effectively with stakeholders at every level of the organisation.
• You bring natural authority in complex industrial environments.
Methodology / certification requirements

• VCA-Vol is mandatory.
• PMP / Prince2 is considered a plus.
Language proficiencies

• Dutch: Native / Fluent
• English: Fluent

Responsibilities

• Collect and process production data from sources such as process historians, MES systems, and sensors.
• Develop robust data pipelines and analytical models using Python and SQL.
• Design and implement Machine Learning models for predictive maintenance and anomaly detection.
• Implement Large Language Model (LLM) applications for document processing and knowledge extraction.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate digital solutions into operational value.
• Document methodologies and results in compliance with GMP requirements.

Requirements

• You bring 3+ years of experience in a data science or analytical role.
• You have advanced proficiency in Python for data analysis and automation, including pandas, scikit-learn, and NumPy.
• You possess strong skills in SQL for relational database management and complex queries.
• You have practical experience building and validating Machine Learning models for time-series and predictive analysis.
• You bring knowledge of Large Language Models (LLM), including fine-tuning and prompt engineering.
• You have experience with IIoT data contextualization using AVEVA PI Asset Framework or Seeq.
• You possess a Master's or Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, or Engineering.
• You are proactive, analytical, and solution-oriented.
• You are fluent in Dutch and English.
Nice to Haves

• Experience in a GMP-regulated environment.
• Knowledge of WERUM PAS-X or other MES systems.
• Familiarity with DeltaV DCS or process control systems.
• Experience using Cursor or Claude for code development.

• Establish governance rituals (steerco, working groups, decision logs, reporting) and ensure timely escalation with the CoE.
 

Standards & processes enablement

• Prepare decision materials for executives; manage trade-offs in a politically sensitive, multi-stakeholder landscape.
 

Tooling & integration

• Coordinate assessment/selection of governance tooling (model registry, risk assessment workflow, monitoring, evidence repository); align with existing data Governance and Risk frameworks.
 

Quality, controls & reporting

• Ensure validation of deliverables and controls with contributing teams, measure adoption, compliance and effectiveness.
• Report progress to management lines and interest groups; handle escalations together with the Data Governance CoE.
 

Transition management

• Document the operating model and handover plan; support the recruitment/selection of the internal capability owner and ensure a smoot

Profile

• You hold a master’s degree in IT, Engineering, Business Engineering or equivalent experience.
• You have 5–10+ years in program/project management for transversal governance, regulatory or risk initiatives; AI/Data governance exposure is a strong plus.
• You have demonstrable experience orchestrating multi‑stakeholder programs with senior visibility and political sensitivity.
• You are comfortable operating in agile environments; familiarity with Scrum/Kanban is a plus.
• You are proactive, structured, and delivery‑driven, balancing pragmatism with compliance needs.
• You have excellent interpersonal & communication skills and adapt your style to technical and non‑technical audiences, including executives.
• You thrive in complex, evolving contexts and can structure ambiguity into clear decisions, actions, and tracking.
• You are fluent in English (written and spoken); French or Dutch is a plus.
• Familiarity with EU AI Act, GDPR intersections, model risk management, and audit requirements.
• Experience with Collibra or related governance platforms; exposure to ML model registries/monitoring.
• Background in risk assessment methodologies (e.g., impact assessments, control testing).

Navision, order processing and follow-up form the core of the role – but the position is clearly broader than traditional order administration. 

As Administrative Officer – Technical Sales Support & Logistics, you are a key link between customers, suppliers and your colleagues. As you gain experience, you can also become more involved in logistics follow-up and the administrative support of technical projects.
  
• Process and follow up customer orders in Microsoft Dynamics Navision. 
• Prepare quotations, order confirmations and purchase orders. 
• Place orders with suppliers and actively follow up delivery dates. 
• Support customers with questions about parts, spare parts and service. 
• Request prices and quotations from suppliers. 
• Follow up transport, deliveries, incoming goods and stock information. 
• Work closely with sales, project managers, engineers and technicians. 
• Occasionally provide practical support with a delivery or in the warehouse.  
The practical logistics component is limited – around 5 to 10% of the role – but it reflects the way Buhlmann works: colleagues do not constantly draw a line around where one job description ends and another begins.
 
Once you know the organisation well, your responsibilities can expand towards project support, for example project files in SharePoint, material orders, delivery follow-up and administrative preparation for invoicing.

Above all, we are looking for someone who is administratively strong, takes responsibility and shows initiative. 

You preferably have relevant experience in order administration, purchasing, sales support, customer service, logistics administration or a technical sales support role. You do not need to be a technical specialist, but an interest in a technical environment is important.
  
• Experience with an ERP system; knowledge of Navision is a strong advantage. SAP or a comparable system also provides a good basis. 
• You work accurately and in a structured way and can keep several files, deliveries and deadlines under control at the same time. 
• You take initiative: if a supplier needs to be chased or a file needs further investigation, you do not simply wait. 
• You are collegial and practically minded and do not mind occasionally helping with a delivery. 
• You are fluent in Dutch and can communicate professionally in English. French is a clear advantage; German is a welcome extra.
